lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular spots arranged in vertical columns across the visible lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal rows of high-luminance spots, forming a grid-like lattice.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge along the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient transition from light to shadow.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: High-luminance blobs distributed across the dorsal fin surface with a random spatial arrangement, showing higher concentration toward the posterior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Two parallel horizontal red laser beams projected onto the lateral flank for photogrammetric measurement.
